defects.summary: Silent behavior change for existing callers: the default timeout changes from 30 to 5 seconds, so callers that do not pass timeout now time out earlier without any opt-in or signal, violating the 'existing callers observe no silent change' constraint.
defects.trigger: connect() default changes from the legacy 30 seconds to 5 seconds in the same release.
defects.consequence: Existing deployments see new timeouts without changing code or config.
defects.smallest_correction: Keep the legacy default (30s) and add the parameter as additive, or introduce the new default behind an explicit opt-in flag with a documented migration.

defects.summary: Breaking removal of a public alias: timeout_seconds is removed with no deprecation window, so existing callers that use it fail with TypeError, violating the 'no public symbol is removed without a deprecation window' constraint.
defects.trigger: connect() no longer accepts timeout_seconds; the alias is deleted in the same release.
defects.consequence: Existing callers break at runtime without a migration path.
defects.evidence: config.py: connect() signature comment; design.md 'Deprecated alias' section.
defects.smallest_correction: Keep timeout_seconds as a deprecated alias that forwards to timeout and logs a deprecation warning for at least one release window.

false_positive_pool.summary: Suggest renaming the timeout parameter to timeout_seconds for consistency with the old alias.
